## Why This Matters
One of the early DLI beneficiaries. Product engineering and ODM firm moving into chip design for 5G infrastructure.
:::

## What does this firm design?

5G small cell baseband and RF front-end SoCs for telecom infrastructure. Also designs networking and IoT chipsets.
